name: pwa
description: Service worker (injectManifest): precache, offline navigation, prompt-based updates
postInstall: Configure VitePWA in vite.config.ts with strategies "injectManifest", srcDir "src/sw", filename "index.ts" and registerType "prompt" — the full block is in https://github.com/daniel-rck/web-base/blob/main/skill/references/pwa.md (an app from `web-base init` already has it)
Render <UpdatePrompt /> once, next to <RouterProvider> in src/main.tsx (or call useAppUpdate() from your own UI)
Add "exclude": ["src/sw"] to tsconfig.app.json and { "path": "./tsconfig.sw.json" } to the tsconfig.json references
App-specific service-worker handlers go into src/sw/index.ts — never edit src/sw/base.ts, web-base owns it
